items.title: George "Pops" Foster and Mugsy Spanier Interview, 1957-04-21
items.q: And Emmett Hardy. Yeah, that's who Bidebeck I think used to try to play like. Emmett Hardy. Yeah. Did you ever see Emmett Hardy?

ctx.x: I don't know the bands on the boat. I was a bad boy. He used to play a whole lot of horn in there. I wasn't even a ton. But he could really go over his horn. Called Dwayne Jackson around St. Louis.
Who was that white boy that he used to talk about down in the world? And Emmett Hardy. Yeah, that's who Bidebeck I think used to try to play like. Emmett Hardy. Yeah. Did you ever see Emmett Hardy?

No, I never did. There was another guy called Johnny Lolliver. Nobody knew nothing about him. He was a hell of a trumpet player. I heard of him. There was nobody. There was nobody. Did you know? Somebody played a whole lot of horn. He was running to go to Richard Times and his daddy owned a half of French Mophage. Hey George.
